description: Empirical TTFT samples for subscription-provider Minimax M2.5 experiments.

sample_semantics.chutes: Per-request TTFT from an internal joint online run, filtered to successful rows with direct Chutes transport.
sample_semantics.featherless: Hourly direct-probe snapshots against the Featherless endpoint; the probe used one request per snapshot.
sample_semantics.minimax: Hourly direct-probe snapshots against the MiniMax native endpoint; the probe used one request per snapshot.

collection.chutes: Successful streaming requests from an internal joint online run, filtered to direct Chutes transport.
collection.featherless: Successful hourly direct-probe snapshots against the Featherless endpoint; the probe used one request per snapshot.
collection.minimax: Successful hourly direct-probe snapshots against the MiniMax native endpoint; the probe used one request per snapshot.
